final:
-- Spec: pick one element of a non-empty list, deterministically from a seed.
-- Index is seed % len, using floor modulo so negative seeds stay in range.
-- No nondet or random: same list and seed always give the same element.

pick(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> int =
  pre xs.len() > 0
  post out == xs[seed % xs.len()]
  ex pick([10, 20, 30], 0) == 10
  ex pick([10, 20, 30], 4) == 20
  ex pick([10, 20, 30], -1) == 30
  xs[seed % xs.len()]

test_pick() =
  assert pick([10, 20, 30], 0) == 10
  assert pick([10, 20, 30], 4) == 20
  assert pick([10, 20, 30], -1) == 30
  assert pick([10, 20, 30], 7) == pick([10, 20, 30], 7)
